title: A Perron-Volterra Lyapunov function for mathematical epidemiology reaction networks (MERN) with non-interacting rank-one strains
summary: This paper introduces a general framework for analyzing global asymptotic stability (GAS), competitive exclusion, coexistence, and persistence in mathematical epidemiology reaction networks. The authors construct Perron-Volterra Lyapunov functions to yield competitive-exclusion GAS partitions of the parameter space. This applies to bilinear m-strain models with non-interacting, irreducible rank-one infection blocks.
